final_validity_verdict.primary_justification: The Phase 6.4 confirmatory evaluation dataset contained 149 post-failure recovery windows that directly violated the frozen protocol's explicit temporal censoring specification: 'censored lookahead (< 1800s without FINISH) or post-failure step -> label -1 (strictly excluded)' (protocol Amendment 2.1 line 201). This violation occurred due to an implementation defect in TargetLabelGenerator.derive_label_for_task (src/labeling/target_generator.py lines 73-77), which omitted checks for prior failure events when future failure events were absent, silently labeling post-failure telemetry as NORMAL (0). An additional 7 pre-failure normal windows had 5-step input histories that crossed a prior failure event.
final_validity_verdict.invariance_of_operational_verdict: Crucially, diagnostic counterfactual analysis proves that this material violation did not affect the study's scientific outcome. When all 149 post-failure windows are censored (Scenario 1), or when all 296 failure-cohort normal windows are excluded (Scenario 2), all four models still fail both the Window FPR gate (17.43% - 33.91% vs. 5.0% threshold) and the Entity FAR gate (31.82% - 64.14% vs. 12.0% threshold) by wide margins. The official operational conclusion remains immutable: NO_OPERATIONAL_WINNER.

critical_horizon.enforcement: Strict retrospective sliding window; earliest abnormal failure event in (t, t + 15m]

warning_horizon.enforcement: Strict retrospective sliding window; earliest abnormal failure event in (t + 15m, t + 30m]

normal_horizon.definition: time_to_failure > 1800.0s with >= 1800.0s follow-up or FINISH event -> y=0
normal_horizon.enforcement: No failure in (t, t + 30m] AND verified active survival for at least 30m or normal FINISH

unknown_censored_and_post_failure.definition: censored lookahead (< 1800s without FINISH) or post-failure step -> label -1 (strictly excluded)
unknown_censored_and_post_failure.enforcement: Observations following a task failure event must be labeled UNKNOWN (-1) and strictly excluded from evaluation

operational_gates.entity_far_gate: <= 12.0% across 198 evaluable pure-normal entities (max 23 alert entities)
operational_gates.window_fpr_gate: <= 5.0% across 4,811 primary normal windows (max 240 false positive windows)

scenario_0_as_frozen.description: Exact ratified evaluation manifest as executed in Phase 6.4 (N=5,511 windows, 4,811 normal windows).

scenario_1_exclude_post_failure.description: Excludes the 149 post-failure recovery windows that violated the protocol's post-failure censoring rule (N=5,362 windows, 4,662 normal windows).

scenario_2_pure_normal_only.scenario_name: Scenario 2: Censoring All 296 Failure-Cohort Normal Windows
scenario_2_pure_normal_only.description: Evaluates Normal false alarm behavior strictly on the 4,515 pure-normal control windows (N=5,215 windows, 4,515 normal windows).

scenario_3_strictly_clean_history.description: Retains only strictly clean pre-failure and pure-normal observations (N=5,355 windows, 4,655 normal windows).

event_type_mapping.detail: Accurately used event_type == 3 (FAIL in Google Cluster Trace 2011 schema).

timestamp_unit_consistency.detail: Microsecond timestamps correctly divided by 1e6 to yield seconds, matching telemetry grid seconds.

episode_reconstruction.detail: All 141 failure episodes matched raw trace events within 0.1s.

reconciliation_147_pre_vs_149_post.detail: Independently verified that failure-cohort normal windows partition into 147 pre-failure and 149 post-failure windows.

phase6_7_limitation_identified.detail: While Phase 6.7 correctly resolved the temporal partition (147 pre-failure vs. 149 post-failure), it failed to recognize that the 149 post-failure windows represented a direct violation of protocol Amendment 2.1 line 201 ('post-failure step -> label -1 (strictly excluded)'). Phase 6.7 treated the 149 post-failure windows as legitimately evaluated cohort members rather than censored data contamination.

unresolved_limitations_and_scientific_di: The 149 post-failure normal windows must be formally documented as a protocol censoring violation in the paper.
The Phase 6.4 confirmatory cohort is permanently unblinded and contaminated; it cannot be reused for model training, tuning, or threshold selection.
The operational failure of the L=5 framework is robust and invariant across all censoring interpretations: all models fail both operational gates by wide margins in every counterfactual.
Any future evaluation must use an updated TargetLabelGenerator that strictly censors post-failure steps and tests on a fresh holdout.
